modelOverview: Launched at Baselworld 2013 as the successor to the ref. 5127, the Calatrava 5227 stepped the collection up to a 39mm case while keeping the automatic Calibre 324 S C at its heart. Its signature is the officer's-style hinged caseback, a nod to Patek's vintage military watches, which opens on a hinge to reveal the movement through a sapphire window rather than requiring a caseback tool. Offered over the years in white, rose and yellow gold with ivory, black or salmon lacquered dials, the 5227 line has been progressively retired since 2026, making surviving examples increasingly sought after on the secondary market.

5227G-001.description: The 5227G-001 is the original white gold execution of Patek Philippe's Calatrava 5227, distinguished by its ivory lacquered dial and the officer's-style hinged caseback that opens to display the automatic Calibre 324 S C. A now-discontinued reference later replaced in the white gold line by the black-dial 5227G-010, it remains prized for its clean, dressy proportions at 39mm. Every example we offer is sourced and fully authenticated before sale.
